target: acceptance 2 — a triage appended after two blind attempts, just before blocked, does NOT satisfy the requirement. It must precede the second attempt.
cmd: e=$("$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/lib/triage.sh" validate "$FIXTURES/triage/late.md" 2>&1 >/dev/null); c=$?; n=$(printf "%s" "$e"|grep -ci "before\|precede\|too late"); printf '{"c":%s,"names":%s}' "$c" "$n"
